camera_oracle: Per view and half, fit the existing per-cell/bin RGB constants from physical second-hit labels. Use sum throughput squared times unweighted residual radiance divided by sum throughput squared, channel-wise. For unsupported lanes only, fill with the paired independent area oracle. Validate on the saved WL105 camera seeds; all camera-oracle values are privileged diagnostics.
camera_evaluation: Reuse the source, dimensions, mask, pair-seed and geometry from the WL105 1024-spp result. Re-render only area and camera oracle tables. Reproduce LOW for all compared paths. Analyze full-resolution, 8x8 coarse and 8x8-residual detail; report signed energy and cross-half mean-square terms.

light_view_cross.description: Cross the two original viewing configurations with the two original environment rotations. Reuse the learned per-light tables, trace physical HIGH and compare pooled luminance.

scope: One static attribution on frozen WL105. No training, patch or transport changes. Area-oracle tests replace prediction error while preserving the patch-domain average and readout. Camera-oracle tests address area-to-camera distribution mismatch within the same per-bin constant model.
